company.name: Cinder
company.shortDescription: Cinder provides software and services for trust and safety, moderation, investigations, and digital safety operations.
company.description: Cinder develops software for trust and safety operations. Its platform manages content moderation, investigations, case workflows, policies, enforcement actions, human review, quality assurance, detection models, and operational metrics. Cinder provides tools for organizations to combine automated and human decisions, evaluate model and reviewer performance, and maintain records for compliance and oversight. The company also offers managed moderation, data labeling, applicant screening, and red-teaming services for digital products and AI systems.
